description: This file defines the CameraPreview class, a custom SurfaceView that manages camera preview display, handling lifecycle events like surface creation, change, and destruction, and calculating display orientation based on device rotation and camera information.

classes.name: CameraPreview
classes.description: A custom SurfaceView for displaying camera preview, handling surface lifecycle callbacks, and adjusting display orientation based on device rotation and camera info.

methods.name: CameraPreview
methods.description: Constructor initializing the CameraPreview with context, camera object, camera info, and display orientation; sets up the SurfaceHolder callback.

methods.name: surfaceCreated
methods.description: Callback invoked when the surface is created; sets the camera preview display and starts the preview.

methods.name: surfaceDestroyed
methods.description: Callback invoked when the surface is destroyed; placeholder for cleanup actions.

methods.name: surfaceChanged
methods.description: Callback invoked when the surface changes; handles stopping and restarting the camera preview, adjusting orientation accordingly.

methods.name: calculatePreviewOrientation
methods.description: Static method to compute the correct display orientation for the camera preview based on camera info and device rotation.
